limitations: SURVIVORSHIP BIAS: universe is current index membership; historical constituents are unavailable token-free — results are exploratory with a research_only ceiling.
Financial statement values are the CURRENT VINTAGE (latest restatement) with original announcement dates; as-originally-reported vintages are unavailable from the token-free feed.
equity_issued is approximated as the increase in share capital at par (~1 CNY/share) between consecutive annual periods.
tri/tri_open use the qfq wealth index anchored to the latest bar (dividend reinvestment at ex-date close assumed).
buyable/sellable are 1 for every observed bar; suspensions appear as missing bars and are handled by the stale-mark/order-expiry machinery.
No delisting events: delisting proceeds are unknown in this universe.
Bars rows dropped by pre-validation: 1 (1 symbols affected).
Fetch failures disclosed: bars ok=466/467, listing failures=42, financial failures=47, action-batch failures=2.
